narrative.northStar: The DIN 6771 / ISO 5457 Engineering Drawing Sheet
narrative.overview: Every backend system, concurrency invariant, and empirical research pipeline built by Son Thien Nguyen is presented as an authentic, stamped mechanical/systems engineering specification sheet. Instead of conforming to generic modern portfolio conventions—floating rounded glass cards, soft diffuse gradients, and decorative stats—this visual system draws from the discipline of industrial blueprints and technical drawings. The aesthetic philosophy is grounded in physical drafting materiality: warm drafting vellum paper, carbon drafting ink, structural blueprint cobalt for structural routing, and signal vermilion for high-contention failure boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic Drafting Materiality: Physical vellum ground with ink coordinate rules and exposed drafting dimensions (--cell).
Telemetry as Structure: Live concurrency traces, ACID row-lock state machines, and empirical benchmark reductions replace decorative fluff.
Strict Visual Restraint: Zero arbitrary gradients, zero soft floating box shadows, zero decorative pulse animations, and zero kickers or eyebrows.
High-Density Technical Scannability: Monospaced tabular data aligned to technical drawing ledgers for instant inspection by engineering hiring managers.

rules.name: The Verification Invariant Rule
rules.body: Signal vermilion (#C82810) is reserved strictly for high-contention signals, conflict indicators, and the singular primary conversion action. It never appears as a decorative accent or ambient glow.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All numerical readouts, coordinate identifiers, and concurrency ratios must use monospaced fonts (Fira Code) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to ensure exact column alignment across variable data states.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation is communicated through ink weight, border contrast, and cross-hatch texture. Drop shadows are strictly prohibited on in-page content containers.

dos: Do maintain strict square geometry (rounded-none, 0px) on all interactive and structural elements.
Do format all telemetry readouts, ratios, and benchmark numbers in font-mono with tabular-nums.
Do ensure all text color combinations maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1).
Do constrain long paragraphs to max-w-prose with text-pretty to prevent reading fatigue.
Do use authentic cross-hatch shading (.hatch-zone) to indicate concurrency load and contention zones.
donts: Don't add rounded corners (rounded-lg, rounded-full) to containers or buttons.
Don't use soft diffuse drop shadows or glassmorphism gradients on page content cards.
Don't add decorative pulsing animations (animate-pulse) to static status badges.
Don't place eyebrow labels or decorative kickers above major section headings.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards with drop shadows.
